servers.description: Separately started model server (modelServer "connect"): llama-server with a model that the customer downloads, at 127.0.0.1:8080. This package contains no language model. To let ticket-demo.exe start it, add "executable" and "args" (CONFIGURATION.md) and set application.modelServer to "start".
